text: DSH Principal Binding Proof 是面向 DSH 工具面的离线主体绑定证据插件，用于检查显式清单是否把同一伪名 authority 与 tenant 从 principal、session、agent、tool-call、runtime 一直绑定到 artifact。它提供清单摘要检查，以及完整绑定链验证；验证会核对哈希、revision、新鲜度、key epoch、issuer、有效期、撤销状态和链路结构，并在工作区写入内容寻址报告。适合需要对脱敏执行记录进行一致性核验的 DSH 开发者；代码未要求 API key 或外部服务。

DSH Principal Binding Proof is a plugin that checks pseudonymous authority and tenant bindings across principal, session, agent, tool-call, runtime, and artifact records. It verifies hashes, freshness, issuers, validity, revocation, and chain structure, then saves a content-addressed report.
想核对一份脱敏的 DSH 执行记录里主体和租户是否一路一致
帮我检查 principal 到 artifact 之间的绑定链有没有断开或失效
需要把清单验证结果保存成可复核的内容寻址报告
DSH Principal Binding Proof 的功能「绑定链验证」：核对清单中主体、租户和执行节点是否构成有效链。通过 DSH 工具输入清单路径与报告目录，生成内容寻址验证报告。

dsh-principal-binding-proof README · dsh-principal-binding-proof：**Maintainer / Author：He Fangsheng (贺方升 / 贺去病; also known as Dosen) · [hequbing.com](https://www.hequbing.com)**

Offline, content-addressed evidence that one pseudonymous authority and tenant remain consistently bound across a DSH execution chain: principal → session → agent → tool call → runtime → artifact.

dsh-principal-binding-proof README · dsh-principal-binding-proof：It validates explicit recorded hashes, revision, key epoch, evidence freshness, issuer allowlists, validity windows, revocation, adjacency and a unique acyclic chain. It detects authority swaps, cross-tenant confusion, stale identities, broken or mis-typed bindings, unauthorized issuers and terminal artifact mismatches.

dsh-principal-binding-proof README · Boundary：This is not authentication, authorization, signature verification, access control or a remote transport. It grants no authority, reads no accounts, credentials, prompts or business payloads, and executes no commands.

dsh-principal-binding-proof README · Boundary：- `dsh-decision-effect-proof` reconciles authorization decisions with effects.
- `dsh-attestation-proof` verifies signed DSSE/in-toto statements.
- `dsh-lineage` tracks object and action provenance.
- This plugin checks the narrower identity-confusion question: whether every redacted execution surface claims the same authority, tenant and revision through a valid explicit binding chain.

See [`examples/bound.json`](examples/bound.json).

dsh-principal-binding-proof README · Boundary：```bash
npm test
npm run check
node bin/dsh-principal-binding-proof.mjs verify examples/bound.json
dsh plugin --profile proof add .

DSH tools are `dsh_principal_binding_inspect` and `dsh_principal_binding_verify`. MCP exposes proof-only inline equivalents. Workspace verification accepts only relative, non-symlink paths and writes a deterministic content-addressed report beneath an explicit `artifactDir`, followed by SHA-256 read-back verification.

dsh-principal-binding-proof README · dsh-principal-binding-proof：作者 / 维护者：He Fangsheng (贺方升 / 贺去病; also known as Dosen)· [hequbing.com](https://www.hequbing.com)

离线、内容寻址的“主体绑定证据层”：验证同一个伪名 authority 与 tenant 是否沿 principal → session → agent → tool-call → runtime → artifact 保持一致，并检查 revision、key epoch、新鲜度、允许 issuer、有效期、撤销、相邻关系和唯一无环链。

它专抓身份替换、跨租户串线、陈旧身份、断链、关系错位、未授权 issuer 与最终 artifact 错绑。它不做登录、认证、授权、签名验证或远程传输，不读取账户、凭据、提示词和正文，也不执行命令。
dsh-principal-binding-proof README · dsh-principal-binding-proof：与 `dsh-decision-effect-proof`、`dsh-attestation-proof`、`dsh-lineage` 互补，不实现第二套权限核心。示例见 [`examples/bound.json`](examples/bound.json)。
